notes.title: Update 1.08
notes.notes:
[b]Procedural Level Generator Complete!!![/b]
Access the Gogh Caves through the Quest Board in the Guild Hall.
-As always, if you find any bugs tell me here and feel free to tell me your thoughts. Want the Dungeon to be longer and harder, tell me here ;) :P

[b]News: It's Finally Time! [/b]
I will be starting to code a sword-based VR game. When it is finally completed, I will continue to update this game & show some love to Null G!

notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.notes:
[b]Floor Lvl 4 Released! [/b]

[b]Collection Quest UI updated to show Gold/ea. [/b]

[b]Goal for next patch is to have an auto level generator for side quests. [The Gough Caves] Hopefully I can get it fully functioning with multiplayer! Follow up updates will hopefully include support for the Index and Vive. This is very hard for me to test without additional headsets, but high on my list. More good stuff to come! [/b]

notes.title: Update 1.06a
notes.notes:
[b]Floor Lvl 3 Released![/b]
Patch [a] | Fixed Floor Lvl 3 starting point. (I had it set next to the boss room for debugging... Whoops)

Lighting bug on Floor Lvl 2 is related to me using too many glow cubes in the level, but I kind of like it so I'm going to leave it as is :P

More good stuff will be coming soon! Until then as always if you catch any bugs or have any comments leave them here and I'll get to them eventually :D

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.notes:
[b]Floor Lvl 2 Released![/b]
I am aware of a lighting bug that makes certain areas of the map glow more than they should, but it is not game breaking, and I can't seem to fix it, so we'll just ship it as is.

I still need to work on the multiplayer features, so I am letting you know that it is on my list :)

If you find any other bugs or have comments/ thoughts on the game's progression comment on the thread and I can add it to the list!
